items.html: Now we will explain a matter which is discussed elaborately and then we will explain the superficiality of the above-mentioned text. First we will explain the matter of the order of the degrees of the Olamot and how they stood in the beginning, before Adam was created, and also how they descended from their degree after he had sinned. Know, that the number of the Olamot itself did not change and they are always four, Atzilut, Beria, Yetzira Assiya.
